elements.requirement: Any person is permitted to inspect and make copies of, or of any part of, the register of title.
elements.quote: Any person may inspect and make copies of, or of any part of— (a) the register of title

elements.requirement: Any person is permitted to inspect and make copies of, or of any part of, any document kept by the registrar that is referred to in the register of title.
elements.quote: any document kept by the registrar which is referred to in the register of title

elements.requirement: Any person is permitted to inspect and make copies of, or of any part of, any other document kept by the registrar that relates to an application made to the registrar.
elements.quote: any other document kept by the registrar which relates to an application to him

elements.requirement: Any person is permitted to inspect and make copies of, or of any part of, the register of cautions against first registration.
elements.quote: the register of cautions against first registration

elements.requirement: The statutory right to inspect and make copies is subject to rules.
elements.quote: The right under subsection (1) is subject to rules

elements.requirement: Rules may provide for exceptions to the right to inspect and make copies.
elements.quote: provide for exceptions to the right

elements.requirement: Rules may impose conditions on the exercise of the right to inspect and make copies, including conditions that require the payment of fees.
elements.quote: impose conditions on its exercise, including conditions requiring the payment of fees
